annotations.title: Departed vntil a time.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> No maruel if the diuel be often or alwaies buſie vvith Chiſtian men, ſeeing after he was plainely ouercome by Chriſt, yet did he not giue him ouer altogether, but for a time.

annotations.title: Done in Capharnaum.
annotations.text: ◦ God maketh choiſe of perſons and places where he worketh miracles or doeth benefits, though he might doe the ſame els where if it liked his wiſedom. So doth he in doing miracles by Saints, not in al places, nor towards al perſons, but as it pleaſeth him. Aug. ep. 137.

notes.text: Miracles at one place and not at an other.

annotations.title: Paſſing through the middes of them.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Either by making him ſelf inuiſible, or alſo more wonderfully, penetrating the multitude and paſſing through them, as he did through the doore, his body either being without ſpace of place, or with other bodies in one place. By al which and the like his doings mentioned in the Goſpel, it is euident that he can alter and order his body as he liſt, aboue the natural conditions of a body.

notes.text: Christs body conteined in place aboue nature.

annotations.title: Simons wiues mother.
annotations.text: ◦ It is euident that Peter had a wife, but after his calling to be an Apoſtle, he leaft her, as S. Hierom writeth in many places ep. 34. c. 2. ad Iulianum. Li. 1. adu. Iouin. See the Annot. Matth. 19, 29.
